title: Treasury Laws Amendment (Making Sure Multinationals Pay Their Fair Share of Tax in Australia and Other Measures) Bill 2018
short_title: Treasury Laws Amendment (Making Sure Multinationals Pay Their Fair Share of Tax in Australia and Other Measures) Bill 2018

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would revise research and development tax incentives and international tax rules, with additional changes for offshore accommodation bookings and cars repaired overseas.
Smaller eligible research companies would receive an offset linked to their company tax rate plus 13.5 percentage points, while larger companies’ premiums would depend on research intensity.
The research measures would generally apply to income years beginning from 1 July 2018, with different application dates for the other tax and administrative changes.
changes: The research expenditure threshold would increase from $100 million to $150 million and become permanent.
Research offset refunds would generally be capped at $4 million annually, excluding qualifying clinical trial amounts.
Thin capitalisation valuations would be tied to financial statements rather than separate asset revaluations.
Offshore accommodation booking suppliers would count relevant Australian accommodation supplies towards goods and services tax turnover.
Luxury car tax would be removed from cars re-imported after overseas servicing, repair or refurbishment.
Significant global entity rules would cover qualifying groups headed by entities other than listed companies.
summary.affected: Research companies, multinational groups, offshore accommodation suppliers and importers of cars refurbished overseas are affected.

speeches.speaker: Christopher Pyne
speeches.brief: The speaker listed three bills: the Treasury Laws Amendment (Making Sure Multinationals Pay Their Fair Share of Tax in Australia and Other Measures) Bill 2018, the Treasury Laws Amendment (Black Economy Taskforce Measures No. 2) Bill 2018, and the Excise Tariff Amendment (Collecting Tobacco Duties at Manufacture) Bill 2018.
